:notebook: *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`

This is occurrence **#40** (resurfaced because `occurrences % 10 == 0` — the noise-reduction guardrail for chronic issues).

**Trajectory**: 38 → 40 occurrences in this single backlog-recovery cycle (G2 + G5). first_seen 2026-05-20, now 7 days of chronic fires. `fix_status: needs-ops-decision`.

**Latest signature (G5, 09:29–09:33Z 2026-05-27):**
• 62 method-ui XHR errors in window
• 74% concentration on `back2internationalltd` (46/62)
• 100% on canonical syncwidget `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/.../GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` path
• Monitor 77419271 last_triggered_ts 09:33:11Z = 1s exact-second match to satellite

**Playbook (from KB):**
1. Confirm chronic baseline — ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume in window vs same window 24h ago (delta <20% = chronic)
2. Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath — if dominant paths under microservices.methodlocal.int, it's pool-level
3. **Check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first** — DNS bursts present here as Ocelot timeouts
4. Decision tree: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout, (b) scale/recycle microservices IIS pool, (c) profile upstream microservice

**Open Jira:** none yet (KB `fix_jira: null` — would be worth filing one given the 40-occurrence cadence)

**Source alerts (G5 — 2 total, plus G2's earlier 11 are covered in the same KB bump):**
  • https://method-software.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1779874152691869  (alert-frontend-errors, 09:29 UTC primary)
  • https://method-software.slack.com/archives/C03TYHGRS23/p1779874392545129  (alert-frontend-errors, 09:33 UTC satellite — 1s monitor match)

**Evidence:**
  • DD monitor 77419271: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271
  • DD logs (G5 window): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-ui%20status%3Aerror%20%2Axhr%2A&from_ts=1779873900000&to_ts=1779874500000&live=false
  • Kibana: https://ca8e80d7f930400fb386a29477353efa.kb.us-west-1.aws.found.io:9243/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-05-27T09:25:00Z',to:'2026-05-27T09:35:00Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'fields.SourceContext:%22Ocelot.Responder.Middleware%22'))

**Cycle context:** This is a 13h cron-stall backlog recovery. 18 messages in 7 groups, all but G5 either KI-suppressed (G2) or low-impact actionable.md (G1/G3/G4/G6/G7). G5 is the only DM going out.

**Stability-review nudge:** the same KI fires every 10 alerts will keep DMing you indefinitely under current rubric. Consider whether 40-occurrence chronic warrants escalation to Jira/PIR vs continuing to absorb noise.
